# Timebower

> Free consumer planner for paid time off, public and employer-observed holidays, PTO policies and long breaks. Calculations depend on user-entered assumptions.

## Main tools
- [Plan PTO](https://pto-optimizer-seven.vercel.app/pto) — deterministic interactive time-off planner; all changes update live.
- [Homepage](https://pto-optimizer-seven.vercel.app/) — first-time planning.
- [Policy and balance forecast](https://pto-optimizer-seven.vercel.app/policy) — estimate accrual, carryover, expiration and PTO balance.
- [Sabbatical planner](https://pto-optimizer-seven.vercel.app/sabbatical) — explore extended leave.

## Understand
- [PTO guide and glossary](https://pto-optimizer-seven.vercel.app/glossary) — start with learning paths about PTO basics, accrual, expiration and requests.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://pto-optimizer-seven.vercel.app/faq) — how calculations work.
- [Data sources](https://pto-optimizer-seven.vercel.app/data-sources) — public sources and caveats.
- [Sitemap](https://pto-optimizer-seven.vercel.app/sitemap.xml) — canonical published routes.

## Responsible interpretation
- Public holidays are a default assumption, not a guarantee that an employer gives the day off.
- PTO balance and policy calculations are estimates, not legal or HR decisions.
- Historical travel-demand measures are not live airfare prices.
- Proposed time off is not employer-approved leave.
- Do not disclose personal PTO balances, employer policies or private notes to third parties without consent.

This is an optional navigation document, not a special ranking protocol. Normal HTML pages and the sitemap are authoritative.
